snippet.title: here - a puzzle game | now on iOS | challenges
snippet.description:
here - a puzzle game is now on iOS and has 50+ new puzzles called challenges. All the puzzles are handcrafted and each has its own logic. They will be more complex and challenging than the original 50 levels.


Play Store: https://bit.ly/here-android
App Store: https://bit.ly/here-ios
